SELECT oi2.spu_id FROM t_order_item oi1 INNER JOIN t_order o ON oi1.order_id = o.id AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) INNER JOIN t_order_item oi2 ON oi1.order_id = oi2.order_id AND oi1.spu_id != oi2.spu_id INNER JOIN t_spu s1 ON oi1.spu_id = s1.id AND s1.category_id = #{categoryId} INNER JOIN t_spu s2 ON oi2.spu_id = s2.id AND s2.status = 1 GROUP BY oi2.spu_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
